subject.title: fix(shared): bound ignore-file reads during workspace scans

question: Should workspace scans adopt a fixed 4 MiB ignore-file limit that terminally hides the affected subtree when the policy file cannot be parsed?
rationale: The code safely enforces the proposed rule, but neither the existing dependency contract nor current product behavior selects this threshold or the upgrade-visible fail-closed outcome; an owner must accept that discovery tradeoff.

options.title: Approve current policy
options.body: Accept the 4 MiB cap and terminal subtree exclusion as the security and availability tradeoff for unreadable oversized ignore policies.

options.title: Revise fallback policy
options.body: Keep bounded reads but require a different threshold, diagnostic, or oversized-file outcome before landing.

recommendation.title: Approve current policy
recommendation.body: Accept the 4 MiB cap and terminal subtree exclusion as the security and availability tradeoff for unreadable oversized ignore policies.
